After annealing at 1400°C for 1h, the microstructure consists of featureless matrix phase and dispersed Y-enriched phase and boride, as seen in Fig. 3(a) and XRD pattern identifies that the alloy in this temperature is composed of single α phase
having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%)
For samples annealed at 1380°C (i.e. within the two phase field, α+β), the structure mainly consists of α2, B2 phase, but minor granular γ phase is also observed, as shown in Fig. 3(b)
having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%)
After quenching from 1340°C the structure is mainly composed of α2 and minor B2 phase, so from 1340°C to 1380°C, the alloy enters into (α+β) two-phase field.
having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%)
The image of the representative alloy quenched from 1320°C is shown in Fig. 3(d), which presents the major α2 phase and minor B2 and γ phase.
having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%)
At 1300ºC, the alloy is in (α+γ) two-phase field, after quenching the alloy shows major equiaxed α phase and small volume fractions of γ phase at grain boundaries.
having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%)
When quenching from the lower temperature at 1280°C, the structure consists of more γ lamellae growing into α grain, and the grain boundaries of α grain are not clearly visible.
having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%)

As quenching from the temperature range of 1150°C-1085°C, these alloys show duplex microstructure that is (α2+ γ) lamellar structure and α2 (or B2 phase depending on temperature) as well as γ phase at lamellar colonies boundaries.
having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%)

There is a α→β phase transformation reaction near the temperature of 1105°C, as the circle shown in Fig. 3(h), from the higher magnified image inserted into Fig. 3(h) it can be observed the coexistence of light B2 phase and gray untransformed α2 phase.
having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%)
But quenching from lower temperature 1085°C, the α2 phases at grain boundaries are disappeared, instead of B2 phase locating at the grain boundaries.
having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%)

After the heat treatment at 1400 °C in the single β phase field or at 1300 °C in the near single α phase field, the β phase dissolves completely and the microstructure changes to fully lamellar structure with the average colony size of about 136µm and 158µm, respectively.

The alloy ingot of 9kg used in this study having a nominal composition of Ti-45Al-8Nb-2Mn-0.3B-0.3Y (at.%) was prepared using induction skull melting a mixture of high purity elements (more than 99.9% purity) and master alloys (Nb-Al, Y-Al, Al-Ti-B) under argon atmosphere.
In order to eliminate the porosity, the ingot was HIPed at 1280°C/130 MPa for 4 hrs.
